body.p: On Git Staging, use the Working copy dropdown to switch to another repository that is already loaded in the Git Client.
If the repository is not listed, select Browse to the right of Working copy, then choose a folder from your file system. The selected folder must be a Git repository.

ul.li: When a working copy is opened, the Git Client automatically detects outdated local branches in the background. These are branches linked to remote branches that no longer exist. In this situation, a warning dialog box shows the outdated local branches and gives you the option to delete them.
The outdated local branch detection also runs periodically after a working copy is loaded, every 3.5 hours.
If the current branch is detected as outdated, you must switch to another branch before you can delete it.
